text: ＊で　とびだしてきた　＊などを　＊ひき　たおした！

structure.jp: とびだしてきた　＊などを
structure.en: ＊ and others that came jumping out

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: A verb placed right before a thing describes that thing. とびだしてきた　＊ = '＊ that came jumping out'.

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: くる after a て-form verb says the action comes toward you. とびだしてきた = 'came jumping out at me'.

patterns.name: 〜など
patterns.explanation: など after a thing means 'and others like it'. ＊などを = '＊ and the like'.
